dataset.name: Blue Birds
dataset.citation: Welinder, Branson, Belongie, Perona. The Multidimensional Wisdom of Crowds. NIPS 2010.

source_model.orientation_rule: flip only when calibration accuracy is below 0.5
source_model.reliability_estimator: Beta(1,1) posterior mean after orientation correction
source_model.selection_rule: descending posterior oriented reliability with worker-id tie break

primary_external_checks: calibration-selected top-k heldout accuracy versus label-free hash-ranked source sets
claim_boundary: External source-reliability validation only. This dataset does not validate procedural action models and does not directly evaluate the static-world Bellman policy.
